briefdescription.para: Phase 5 release-gate benchmarks for Phase 2/3 failover hot paths (FP23-01..FP23-06).

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency measurements for the six hot-path operations introduced or hardened in Phase 2 (Core Implementation) and Phase 3 (Error Handling and Edge Cases) of the failover module roadmap.
Results are used as release gates for the Phase 2/3 delivery batch. A regression beyond 10% vs the baseline blocks promotion.

sect2.title: Benchmark families
sect2.para: Measures the switch-based state-machine guard. GATE-FP23-01: p99 ≤ 100 µs
Measures the fast-reject path: pointer check + error-code dispatch. GATE-FP23-02: p99 ≤ 200 µs
Measures std::unique_lock<std::mutex>(m, std::try_to_lock) + owns_lock() overhead on an uncontested mutex. GATE-FP23-03: p99 ≤ 100 µs
Measures a single lock_guard acquisition followed by three uint64_t increments (the batch-flush pattern replacing per-iteration locks). GATE-FP23-04: p99 ≤ 200 µs
Measures FailoverErrorCode → FailoverEventType mapping + iteration over an empty event-callback vector (the typical no-subscriber case). GATE-FP23-05: p99 ≤ 100 µs
Measures the fast-drop path: queue-size check + lock_guard + stats increment. GATE-FP23-06: p99 ≤ 200 µs
